html: <!doctype html><html lang="{{LOCALE}}"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>{{BASE_STYLE}} :root{--c-yellow:#FFD400;--c-orange:#FF9F1C;--c-red:#FF3B30;--c-bubble-right:#FEE500;--c-white:#fff;--c-dark:rgba(0,0,0,0.82);--c-overlay:rgba(0,0,0,0.40);--c-outline:#000;--r-card:18px;--r-bubble:16px;--shadow-text:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.70);--outline-text:-1px -1px 0 #000,1px -1px 0 #000,-1px 1px 0 #000,1px 1px 0 #000;--transition-cut:150ms ease;--ken-dur:6s;}*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}body,main#stage{width:100%;height:100%;background:#111;overflow:hidden;}main#stage{position:relative;}/* ── SCENE BASE ── */.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity var(--transition-cut);}  .scene.active{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;}.scene .mat{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;}.scene .mat img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;will-change:transform;}.scene .copy{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;pointer-events:none;}/* ── KENBURNS ── */@keyframes kb-in{from{transform:scale(1.00) translate(0%,0%);}to{transform:scale(1.10) translate(-5%,-3%);}}@keyframes kb-out{from{transform:scale(1.10) translate(5%,3%);}to{transform:scale(1.00) translate(0%,0%);}}.kb-in{animation:kb-in var(--ken-dur) ease-in-out forwards;}.kb-out{animation:kb-out var(--ken-dur) ease-in-out forwards;}/* ── S1 LOCKSCREEN ── */.scene-lock .mat::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.38);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(0.6);}.lock-time{position:absolute;top:160px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:112px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;letter-spacing:2px;text-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.60);}.lock-date{position:absolute;top:120px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:36px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.90);letter-spacing:1px;text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.50);}.notif-stack{position:absolute;top:360px;left:60px;right:60px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}.notif-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.22);backdrop-filter:blur(28px);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:14px 18px 16px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-36px);transition:opacity 240ms ease,transform 240ms ease;}.notif-card.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}.notif-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.30);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}.notif-icon svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:#fff;}.notif-body{flex:1;}.notif-sender{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1.2;}.notif-msg{font-size:24px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.92);line-height:1.4;margin-top:2px;}/* ── S2–S4 CAPTION BAR ── */.caption-bar{position:absolute;top:120px;left:60px;right:60px;}.caption-sub{font-size:46px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1.3;text-shadow:var(--shadow-text);paint-order:stroke fill;-webkit-text-stroke:7px #000;}.caption-cap{font-size:62px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;line-height:1.3;text-shadow:var(--shadow-text);-webkit-text-stroke:8px #000;}.caption-cap .num{-webkit-text-stroke:0;text-shadow:none;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;display:inline-block;min-width:2.4ch;transition:color 180ms ease;}.caption-cap .num.yellow{color:var(--c-yellow);}.caption-cap .num.orange{color:var(--c-orange);}.caption-cap .num.red{color:var(--c-red);}@keyframes pop{0%{transform:scale(1.00);}50%{transform:scale(1.12);}100%{transform:scale(1.00);}}.num.pop{animation:pop 180ms ease;}/* ── BUBBLE STREAM ── */.bubble-stream{position:absolute;bottom:200px;left:60px;right:60px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;overflow:hidden;max-height:420px;justify-content:flex-end;}.bubble{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity 200ms ease,transform 200ms ease;}.bubble.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}.bubble.left .bubble-box{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-bubble) var(--r-bubble) var(--r-bubble) 4px;color:#111;}.bubble.right{flex-direction:row-reverse;}.bubble.right .bubble-box{background:var(--c-bubble-right);border-radius:var(--r-bubble) var(--r-bubble) 4px var(--r-bubble);color:#111;}.bubble-box{padding:12px 18px;max-width:72%;}.bubble-name{font-size:21px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;margin-bottom:4px;color:#555;}.bubble.right .bubble-name{text-align:right;color:#666;}.bubble-text{font-size:28px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.4;}/* ── S5 ENDING ── */.scene.end .mat::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--c-overlay);}.end-copy{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0;padding:60px;}.end-name{font-family:"Nanum Myeongjo","Times New Roman",serif;font-size:88px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;text-align:center;letter-spacing:4px;opacity:0;text-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.60);transition:opacity 600ms ease;}.end-name.show{opacity:1;}.end-rule{width:200px;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.50);margin:28px auto;}.end-tagline{font-size:38px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.92);text-align:center;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:12px;text-shadow:var(--shadow-text);}.end-location{font-size:32px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.75);text-align:center;letter-spacing:1px;text-shadow:var(--shadow-text);}.end-cta{margin-top:40px;font-size:34px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:16px 40px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.70);border-radius:40px;text-shadow:var(--shadow-text);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);}/* ── SCENE TONES ── */.scene:nth-child(1) .mat::after{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.38);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(0.6);}.scene:nth-child(2){}.scene:nth-child(3) .mat::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,0.30) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 60%);}.scene:nth-child(4) .mat::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,0.10) 70%);}</style></head><body><main id="stage">{{SCENES}}</main>{{PLAYER}}</body></html>
